name.description: The display label for this pin

path.description: The filesystem path for this pin. Supports variable expansion with: $DOCUMENTS (user documents directory), $DOWNLOADS (user downloads directory), $MUSIC (user music directory), $PICTURES (user pictures directory), $DESKTOP (user desktop directory), $HOME (user home directory, ~), $VIDEOS (user videos directory), $CONFIG (user config directory). Do not combine variables, it will not work properly. (Follows XDG Base Directory Specification)

default.description: Default pinned folders that appear in the pinned sidebar

pins.description: Custom pinned folders that appear in the pinned sidebar
